'''Gathering Klefki''' (Japanese: '''クレッフィ、集める''' ''{{tt|Cleffy|Klefki}}, Collect'') is the 573rd chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 25th chapter of the {{MangaArc|X & Y}}.

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* [[Clemont]] awakens at the [[Team Flare Secret HQ]].
* [[Xerosic]] holds [[Clemont's Heliolisk]] hostage to force him to build a machine for Team Flare.
* [[Emma|Essentia]] returns to have her Expansion Suit upgraded.
* {{kal|Grace}} manages to get the captured [[Vaniville Town]] residents freed with the help of a wild {{p|Klefki}}.
* {{adv|X}}, {{adv|Trevor}}, {{adv|Tierno}}, and {{adv|Shauna}} continue looking for {{adv|Y}} and they find a passerby Rhyhorn racer that Y has left [[Yvette]] in the care of.
* Y follows [[Celosia]] and [[Malva]] to where [[Xerxer|Xerneas]] is resting.
* Celosia and Malva part ways to begin their plans.
* Y reunites with X and the others.
* Grace frees all the Vaniville residents, only for Celosia to arrive as they are leaving.
* Celosia possesses the Vaniville residents with her {{p|Aegislash}} and begins the operation to move Xerneas.

{{endspoilers}}
